correctness.rationale: Tafazolian Theorem 1.7 gives first-layer rank-2 Fp plane and S=Cp²; Cor.1.8 N_Aut(S)/S=Stab_{k* rtimes C2}(V). In form V=A(1,1), diagonals D_lambda preserve iff lambda²=1 and J fixes V, giving Klein four, normalizer 4p². For V=Fp a(1,1) ⊕ Fp b(1,-1) and r=a/b not Fp, D_lambda acts in this basis as [[c,d/r],[rd,c]], c=(lambda+lambda^-1)/2, d=(lambda^-1-lambda)/2. Stabilizing iff c,rd,d/r in Fp. d !=0 forces r² in Fp; when absent only lambda±1 and Klein four. If delta=r² in Fp, delta nonsquare, lambda=c-ur with c,u in Fp, c²-delta u²=1: cyclic norm-one subgroup Fp²* of order p+1. J inverts it, yielding dihedral group of order 2(p+1) and normalizer 2p²(p+1). Covers every odd p and both forms, not full Aut(X).
